Package be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.util

package be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.util
Shared utility classes for the game logic.

Contains Position (double-precision game-world coordinates), Stopwatch (frame-independent delta-time measurement), and ConfigManager (loading game parameters from .properties files with safe defaults).
